title: Even Better Server Guardian
description: Server-side monitoring mod: TPS guard and player watchlist. Compatible with Even Better Server Owner.
body:
# Even Better Server Guardian

A lightweight server-side mod that keeps operators informed and in control.

## Features

### TPS Guard
Monitors server tick rate in real time. When TPS drops below your configured threshold (default: 17.0), all online operators receive an instant alert — including which chunk has the most entities.

- `/tpsguard status` — view current TPS and top entity hotspots

### Player Watchlist
Track specific players across sessions. Operators are notified when a watched player joins, chats, or breaks blocks.

- `/watch add <player>` — add player to watchlist
- `/watch remove <player>` — remove from watchlist
- `/watch list` — see all watched players
- `/watch log <player>` — view last 20 events

### Config
- `/serverguard reload` — reload config without restarting
- All settings stored in `config/serverguard.json`

## Compatibility with Even Better Server Owner

When **[Even Better Server Owner](https://modrinth.com/mod/even-better-server-owner)** is installed alongside this mod, Guardian automatically enhances watchlist alerts: when a watched player joins, their warning count and mute status from Server Owner are shown inline in the join notification.

Install both mods together for a complete server management suite.
